## Objective and scope

Test whether objective reweighting, support changes, interpolation or scale conventions explain observed anatomy loss; do not assume an implementation bug.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Measure frozen-trial loss versus freshly rebuilt weights/support after accepted steps. Quantify support/variance changes and determine whether loss reduction reflects improved matching or a changed scoring population.
2. Extend directional-derivative checks to problematic acquired-image checkpoints through actual interpolation, gradient, composition, and applicable regularization paths; retain existing synthetic JVM/JS evidence.
3. Run controlled image-order, asymmetric/mixed-grid, orientation, boundary and coarse-to-fine physical-scale checks, separating objective differences from map/interpolation error.
4. Produce falsifiable reproductions with numerical tolerances and a diagnosis of confirmed defects, rejected hypotheses and remaining uncertainty.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/NeighborhoodCc.scala
- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/HalfFlowCcSupport.scala
- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/HalfFlowCcEngine.scala
- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/test/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/

## Blocking prerequisites

- D01 (`bd-01M4X4DY7DQCVK33MCK3T17NA1`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
